name: Wojo Live Rosin | Strawberry Guava
description:
Strawberry Guava - 1g Live Rosin

The cream of the crop.

Strawberry Guava quickly stacks up with lime green buds that are the extractor’s dream.

Her impressive resin production results in a massive hash yield with gorgeous color.

This hash has a guava flavor with floral hints and gives off a euphoric, relaxing, and sometimes sedating high.
